data.text:
Agad ipinatawag ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) ang isang nag-viral na tricycle driver. 

Ang insidente ay naganap noong Enero 17, 2026 bandang alas-10:00 ng gabi sa North Avenue, tapat ng SM North EDSA. 

Makikita sa video na nagkaroon ng komprontasyon sa pagitan ng tricycle driver at sa isa pang motorista na nagmamaneho ng sedan. 

Ayon sa ulat, nag-counterflow umano ang tricycle driver sa bahagi ng North Avenue patungong EDSA kung saan pansamantala itong isinara bunsod ng ginagawang MRT station, dahilan upang magkaroon ng designated counterflow lane sa kabilang linya ng kalsada.

Youth and student groups held a protest outside the Commission on Elections (Comelec) at the Palacio del Gobernador in Intramuros, Manila on Tuesday, January 20. 

The demonstrators called on the poll body to dismiss what they claimed was a manufactured petition for cancellation filed by the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) against Kabataan Party-list. 

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
